$description: Two faces. Pixel Bop, Blip's own pixel font, for big text: always on the grid, always capitals. Pixelify Sans for UI and body text: the one thing allowed off the grid, because a 7-pixel font is too small to read at body sizes.

display.$description: Pixel Bop. Sized in whole scales: 1 em is 10 pixels, caps are 7 pixels tall.

ui.$description: Pixelify Sans, a variable font from 400 to 700. Its grid is 11 pixels to the em, so at 22 px its pixels are Blip pixels.

display-scale.$description: Pixel Bop sizes, as whole scales of the pixel. Font size = 10 x pixel x scale; cap height = 7 x pixel x scale.

size.$description: Pixelify Sans sizes in CSS px. Fixed, not tied to the pixel size, so text stays readable when the pixel grows.

title.$description: Pixelify's pixels land on the 2 px grid.
